new_evidence_class: EXPLORATORY_NEW_EVENT_DESIGN_AFTER_PHYSICAL_EVENT_EXPOSURE; NOT PRISTINE, NOT THE OLD V1.292 GATE
scientific_goal: Check in independent two-island 2017-2019 plant survey whether enough physically matched trail-edge and interior samples exist, *before* any native/alien species values, to support an observational composition contrast. Do not rescue original v1.292 as confirmed.

fixed_event_grammar.year: first dot token, must match numeric Event year (if supplied) and eventDate year
fixed_event_grammar.trail: all dot tokens between year and rightmost 3 tokens; any nonempty trail name accepted, no source-selected trail exclusion
fixed_event_grammar.area: rightmost third token must be 0,50,250,max or Control_50 (exact normalized control50 alias becomes control_50); all other area tokens excluded from available matched frame
fixed_event_grammar.plot: rightmost second token must be 1,2,3; otherwise exclude
fixed_event_grammar.line: rightmost token must be 25,50,100,150; plot2/3 line25 invalid; otherwise exclude
fixed_event_grammar.source_identity: Exclude malformed Event-level records deterministically before opening any Occurrence; never impute or fuzzy-reassign individual missing plots
fixed_event_grammar.full_event_population: Require 210 unique original core IDs and eventIDs, exact fixed original source archive. Report all exclusion reasons and fraction; stop if more than 20 percent cannot be structurally categorized.

fixed_sampling_eligibility.matched_unit: same island×trail×year×area with complete lines 50/100/150 for plot1 and at least one of plot2 or plot3; fixed control of shared line efforts
fixed_sampling_eligibility.independent_blocks: trail, not 210 line events; 3 trails on Terceira and one on São Miguel published; do not pretend island-level independence beyond two islands
fixed_sampling_eligibility.line_25_policy: Report but exclude edge-only 25-cm lines from future matched score

future_score_rules: Only if qualified: separately freeze native/alien taxonomy vocabulary, plot-level detection-based primary difference, ambiguity threshold, and original source-replay rules in a new protocol before reading Occurrence values. No species value used to decide which site groups to include.
